subject: Marketplace billing cutover & usage attribution for Helio Medical
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@helio-med.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@helio-med.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal questions / billing channels

Hi Irene,

Our procurement team is preparing for the July renewal and wants clarity on the marketplace conversion you mentioned during the exec call. Specifically: 1) how will our existing invoice line items map to marketplace SKUs, and 2) how will usage attribution be reported for our internal chargeback?

Can you share a short mapping and a proposed go-live date? We need to route this to finance and our AWS account team.

Thanks,
Alex
Procurement Manager
Helio Medical
[Attachment: current-line-items-helio.pdf (pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@helio-med.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@helio-med.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal questions /billing channels

Hi Alex / Sanjay,

Thanks for the note. We can convert the direct contract to AWS Marketplace billing with a July 15 cutover if that works for your renewal window. High-level plan below: 

- SKU mapping: attach a draft (Helio_Invoice_Mapping.xlsx) that pairs your current invoice lines to Marketplace SKUs and recommended metering dimensions.
- Attribution: Redwood will push usage CSVs to your finance team daily; AWS will also surface Marketplace invoice lines. We recommend using our attribution ID (org tag) so you can reconcile per-department chargebacks.
- Contract amendment: a short amendment (RDW-Helio-Marketplace-Amendment-v1.docx) to convert billing channel and preserve committed spend.

Action items:
1) Review mapping and confirm any renamed SKUs by Thu, Jun 4.
2) Procurement to confirm go-live date and whether you need a monthly or quarterly invoice cadence.
3) Provide sample usage export for us to validate attribution (I've attached a sample format).

Looping in Karthik (channel & marketplace PM) and Laura (renewals) to coordinate DocuSign and AWS co-sell alignment.

Best,
Irene
Senior GTM Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@helio-med.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@helio-med.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal questions / billing channels

Irene / Karthik,

Quick clarifying Qs after looking at the mapping: 
- A couple of our internal codes (HMS-PROCESS-004) combine what you map to two SKUs. Will AWS accept split metering and produce two invoice lines?
- For attribution, can Redwood include an account-level tag in the usage CSV so our finance system (NetLedger) can automatically allocate costs?

We reviewed the amendment and procurement prefers July 20 cutover to allow one more week for testing. We also want to confirm there are no price changes — this must be a channel-only change.

Thanks,
Sanjay
Director, IT Procurement
Helio Medical

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@helio-med.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@helio-med.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@aws-partner.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal questions / billing channels

Thanks Sanjay — answering inline: 

- Split metering: yes, AWS Marketplace supports multiple metered dimensions per customer; Redwood will emit separate usage records for each SKU. We'll provide a mapping file that preserves your HMS codes as a tag so you can re-aggregate if desired.
- Attribution tag: we can include a custom "org_id" and "dept_code" fields in the daily usage export (CSV). That should plug into NetLedger with a simple ingestion job.
- Pricing: no price changes — this is strictly a billing channel shift; amendment preserves committed ARR and unit prices.

Proposed test window: Jun 30 - Jul 6 (sandbox billing + daily usage exports). Production cutover: Jul 20.

Next steps (Karthik):
1) I'll upload the revised mapping with HMS codetags by EOD Jun 5.
2) Ben from AWS can confirm Marketplace metering dimensionality and provide partner contact for invoicing.
3) Laura will prepare the DocuSign amendment once Helio confirms the date.

-Karthik
Head, Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@helio-med.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@helio-med.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@aws-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal questions / billing channels

Thanks everyone — this plan looks good. Two quick confirmations before we execute: 
1) Please include "HMS-PROCESS-004" as a tag on all usage rows for the mapped SKUs. That will make our finance job trivial.
2) We need a single consolidated invoice per month, not daily invoices. Is that possible with the marketplace route?

Assuming yes to both, we approve the Jul 20 cutover. Laura, please send DocuSign when ready and we will route to our legal.

Alex
Procurement Manager
Helio Medical
